SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4491
Date 17/2/33

February 17 33

Dear Mr. O'Brien,

With reference to your verbal inquiry,
I have to state that Mr. Victor Kochetoff is a
member of the Municipal Police.

I return herewith the letter addressed
to you by your New York Office in which reference
is made to him.

Yours sincerely,

Charles F. O'Brien, Esq.,
Nippon Yusen Kaisha,
The Bund.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. REGISTRY
No. D 4491
SECTION
Date 16 / 2 / 33
Date February 16, 1933）

Subject (in full) Confidential letter from the manager of the Nippon Yusen Kaisha,
New York Branch, re: Mr. Victor Kochetov.

Made by D. J. Trofimov Forwarded by （签名）

No. 299/1

With reference to attached letter dated January 4-th,
1933, from the manager of the Nippon Yusen Kaisha, New York Branch,
on the subject of Mr. Victor Kochetov, I have to state that Vic-
tor Kochetoff, Russian, has been serving with the Shanghai Municipal
Police since July 1927. In 1932 he was on long leave returning
in Shanghai via the United States on October 25, by the S.S.
"Asama Maru".

He is a member of the local branch of "Sokol" (a sport-
ing organization which has branches in all Slavonic countries),
and represented it at the "Sokol" Olympic games which were held
in Prague during the summer of 1932.

G. Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch
Victor Kochetov who has been appointed Soviet
Trade Commissioner to Japan is not known in
this Office. （签名） 16/2.

（批：JR）

日期 1933年2月16日）

事由（全称） 日本邮船会社纽约分行经理关于维克多·科切托夫（Victor Kochetov）先生的机密信函。

制作人 D. J. Trofimov 转呈人 （签名）

编号 299/1

关于附呈的1933年1月4日日本邮船会社纽约分行经理
就维克多·科切托夫（Victor Kochetov）先生一事所发信函，
兹声明俄国人维克多·科切托夫（Victor Kochetoff）自1927年7月起
一直在上海公共租界工部局警务处任职。1932年他休长假，
于10月25日乘“浅间丸”号轮船经美国返回上海。

他是“索科尔”（Sokol，一个在所有斯拉夫国家均设有分支的体育组织）
本地分支的成员，并代表该组织参加了1932年夏季在布拉格举行的
“索科尔”奥林匹克运动会。

G. Prokofiev
副督察

特别股主管警官
维克多·科切托夫（Victor Kochetov）已被任命为苏联驻日本贸易专员，
本处对此人并不知晓。（签名） 2月16日。

（批注：JR）

C O P Y.

N. Y. K. Line
(Japan Mail Steamship Co.)

New York

January 4th, 1932.

CONFIDENTIAL

The Manager,
Nippon Yusen Kaisha,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:-

MR. VICTOR KOCHETOV, SECOND CLASS
PASSENGER, SAN FRANCISCO TO SHANG-
HAI, IN "M.V. ASAMA MARU", OCTOBER
6TH, 1932 - (17-H.)

This gentlemen, who was enroute to your City,
represented himself as a member of the Shanghai Municipal
Police Department, and claimed to have represented the
White Russian community of Shanghai at a Sokol (athletic
contest), held at Prague late in the summer. While in
New York City, he fraternized with certain leaders among
the White Russians resident here, and various confidences
appeared to have been exchanged.

It then surprised these same Russians resident
in New York, when they read in the press recently that a
man by the same name, Victor Kochetov, had been appointed
Soviet Trade Commissioner to Japan. Hence, some of these
people have asked us to ascertain, with your assistance,
if the two personalities are identical.

Thanking you for securing the information desired,
if at all possible, we are,

Very truly yours,

Nippon Yusen Kaisha, New York Branch

纽约日本邮船会社航线
（日本邮船株式会社）

纽约

1932年1月4日。

机密

经理，
日本邮船会社，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

维克多·科切托夫（VICTOR KOCHETOV）先生，二等
乘客，1932年10月6日乘“浅间丸”号机动船
从旧金山至上海 - (17-H.)

这位绅士在前往贵市途中，自称是上海公共租界
工部局警务处的成员，并声称曾代表上海的白俄社群
参加夏末在布拉格举行的索科尔（体育竞赛）。在纽约市期间，
他与居住在此的一些白俄领袖交往密切，双方似乎交换了
各种机密信息。

因此，当这些居住在纽约的俄国人最近在报刊上读到
一名同名男子维克多·科切托夫（Victor Kochetov）被任命为
苏联驻日本贸易专员时，他们感到惊讶。故此，其中一些人
请我们协助查明这两个人是否为同一人。

感谢您在可能的情况下获取所需信息，我们是，

您真诚的，

日本邮船会社纽约分行

SFL:JLM                                         经理
抄送：东京
    DFO-NY
